'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Mike Gemme LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Gemme
* '''Deck name:''' Sheep for a wood?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
